description: List your brand's content pages (including drafts). Each row carries `id`, `slug`, `title`, `status`, `template`, `parent_id` and `is_folder` — so this is also how you discover the page TREE. Rows with `is_folder: true` are folders (organizational nodes, no live URL); their `id` is the `folder_id` you pass to content_update_navigation's `source: {kind:'folder', folder_id}` binding.

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: content_list_pages
